question.text: Which category of index includes rule-based smart-beta and factor indices that capture a defined investment strategy?

explanation.text: The Logic: Strategy indices are listed by the workbook as a distinct category of indices and include rule-based smart-beta and factor indices that capture a defined investment style or strategy. Passive funds can use such indices to deliver broader market or strategy return in a transparent, rule-based way. The Trap: Broad market indices are strategy-agnostic representations of the overall market, sectoral indices focus on industries, and dividend-oriented indices focus on a specific income characteristic rather than a packaged strategy. Note: Treat strategy indices as a category defined by rule-based construction and a specific investment objective; verify any specific named index against the latest exchange/index-provider documentation before relying on it in client material.
